options.name: anycast_config_refs
options.description: An array of AnycastConfigRef structures; identifies the anycast configurations that this host is a member of.

options.name: config_bgp
options.description: Defines the BGP configuration for one anycast-enabled on-prem host.

options.name: config_ospf
options.description: Defines the OSPF configuration for one anycast-enabled on-prem host.

options.name: config_ospfv3
options.description: Defines the OSPFv3 configuration for one anycast-enabled on-prem host

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IPv4 address of the on-prem host

options.name: ipv6_address
options.description: IPv6 address of the on-prem host

options.name: name
options.description: A user-friendly name of the host. Example: 'dns-host-1', 'Central Office Server'

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object
